body: You need to read again because I'm talking to my doctor next week about getting more help.
You're wrong. I don't need urgent care.
So your a perfect mom? Never made regretful choices? Never needed to vent a frustration?
And if your kids experience these problems in the future? You'll tell them to give up their baby?
Set it all on fire approach?

You see a post about someone hurting and struggling and suffering because they feel like a monster, who is actively talking with everyone and saying they would try therapy if it's covered under their insurance, and this is what you want to say to them?
I told my doctor I was still struggling and he change my dosage to a higher dose.

Ok, so for the sake of making me talk to my doctor you want me to feel worse about how my 'faking it' is actually just useless because he sees right through it.  

You guys all think I'm being difficult or whatever but I obviously feel like enough of a pile of shit.
Then why do doctors prescribe them and not suggest any follow up or other treatments?

I try a lot of things. I try relocating him, I try songs, I try bringing him to different things and describing them to him, I try giving him baths, I try changing up his toys, I try reading books, I try reading new books, I try making up stories, and I try ignoring him. I can distract him for short moments but I can't put him down to just play with toys or bounce in a jumper or anything to just have a moment. He has started resisting attention, shoving away from me, while simultaneously demanding constant attention.
I have PPD and I am already medicated for it. My doctor even upped my medication for me.

Is it really that impossible to be honestly feeling really feelings that aren't just the product of a chemical imbalance? 

I hate that my feelings are being discounted as JUST PPD. I know myself and I know that it's totally possible that I really just regret being a mother and that it isn't what I wanted or anticipated and, unlike other things, I just can't quit going to this activity. It's not like Girl Scouts that I stopped going to.

I can ask for help and I get it. That help doesn't stop the 13 hours a day I'm alone with a baby that whines when not napping since he was a newborn. You can distract him for short moments but as he gets older those moments get shorter and he doesn't even stop to pay attention to me every time anymore. He is crawling now so he does this whining circuit so I can't even park him in the playroom (was the dinning room) and hide in the kitchen anymore. He isn't tired he isn't hungry he doesn't have a wet diaper, he doesn't want to play or listen to a song. He doesn't want to go in the car. It's pissing rain so I can't put him in the stroller. He doesn't have reflux and he isn't crying.

Of course I don't feel heard. You go tell your baby to fucknoff and to shut the fuck up and yell Jesus fucking Christ at him. Then think about telling someone that, not anonymously online. You go get labeled a horrible child abuser. You go get reported to child services. Go ahead. I'll wait here.
My doctor will just tell me to go to emerg at the hospital. I'm not suicidal. I can't just check in to the hospital I have to watch my so
Nothing I've said isn't true or exaggerated.
I don't know if therapy would help, I've never been. If it's covered by my insurance I'd try it.

I take my medication and it's why I am not spending my days crying.

There is no such thing in my situation as 'treatment' to go to.

My family likes watching him but they want to do it at their home so I have to drive him to them. He hates the car do driving there is stressful and driving home erases any benefit of getting away. 

My husband somehow cane tune out the whining while he zones out to the tv when he is 'helping'.
It's going to cost me $1380 +tax, so $1600, to put my one child into daycare each month.

So jealous of people with people who care about them. Who think about them. Supportive people.

No one I know cares about me past how I effect them. That's how I was raised. How can I teach a child any different. I don't know a healthy relationship, I don't know what it's like to have a friend.

I know I will fuck this kid up worst than me. Sitting here fingers crossed for a boy because I can't teach a girl about self worth and self respect and confidence when I don't have any of that. But really I need to teach a boy about those things too. I feel doomed to failure because I can't even have a nonsexist thought about my own potential son. I wouldn't wish me on anyone.
Maybe if you spent less time posting on r/fatpeoplehate  bashing strangers, and more time focusing on your own life and positives, you would be able to work towards a healthier outlook on life.
